_comment: Tool-facing hardware/address declaration for the Konami Time Pilot board.
timeplt_state::timeplt(machine_config) and ROM_START(timeplt). Same role as the dkong
and thepit files: the single source of truth the shared Python tools read via
--hardware, so tools/ stays game-agnostic. Numbers are decimal (JSON has no 0x);
'_hex' fields are annotations the loader ignores.
NOT YET MEASURED: the boot/NMI landmark cycles. Those need a MAME golden run; they
are left empty rather than guessed.

screen._note: raster 256x256, visarea 0..255 H and 16..239 V -> 256x224 visible; ROT90, which is thepit's orientation and the OPPOSITE of dkong's ROT270 -- see docs/porting.md, getting this backwards ships the display upside down

_refresh_note: set_refresh_hz(60) EXACTLY -- unlike dkong and thepit, which are 60.606061. Do not copy their figure.
_cpu_note: MASTER_CLOCK 18.432MHz / 3 / 2. The driver comments this as 'not confirmed, but common for Konami games of the era'.
_cycles_note: 3072000 / 60. Differs from dkong/thepit (50688) because the refresh differs.

stateRegions.name: color
stateRegions._hex: 0xA000-0xA3FF colour RAM (this board DOES have writable colour, unlike dkong)

stateRegions.name: sprite0
stateRegions._hex: 0xB000-0xB0FF sprite RAM bank 0 (mirror MASK 0x0B00 -- don't-care bits, not an offset)

stateRegions.name: sprite1
stateRegions._hex: 0xB400-0xB4FF sprite RAM bank 1 (mirror MASK 0x0B00 -- don't-care bits, not an offset)

writeRanges.name: sound_latch
writeRanges._hex: 0xC000 sound data to the audio Z80 (READ at the same address returns the scanline counter)

writeRanges.name: mainlatch
writeRanges._hex: 0xC300-0xC30F LS259 B3, bit index = (addr-0xC300)>>1 -- TWO addresses per bit -- with the data on d0: b0=NMI enable, b1=flipscreen (inverted), b2=audio IRQ trigger, b3=audio mute, b4=video enable, b5/b6=coin counters, b7=unused

dsw0._hex_expected: 0xFF -- MEASURED from a MAME run with -noreadconfig, all dips at their default (inactive-high inputs)

_dsw1_note: 0xC200 reads 0x4B under the same defaults; it is a second dipswitch bank, not a mirror
_controlByte_hex: 0xC3 -- ROM 0x0000 first byte (JP 0x07B1, the reset vector); config-probe that the program ROM loaded

z80Reset._hex: MAME Z80 reset: AF=0x0040 (Z flag set), IX=IY=0xFFFF, rest 0 -- same for every MAME Z80

interrupt._note: vblank_irq() asserts INPUT_LINE_NMI only while the mainlatch bit-0 NMI enable is set; clearing that bit clears the line. Same interrupt model as dkong.

_landmarks_todo: measure boot-init-done and first-vblank-NMI cycles from a MAME golden run, as boards/dkong/hardware.json has
